summary: Bridge approach ramp: steep, no parking, no pull-off.
reasons: Raised ramp with barrier, no room

drivers.seclusion: Nearest house 55 m away, but the kerb is a raised bridge ramp beside a rail corridor.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is an embankment edge on the bridge approach with a barrier and no verge or pull-off; no room to stop out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane road onto the bridge, rail line alongside.
drivers.convention: No cars park on this kerb; the nearby grass parkland parking is separate.

flags: Steep: about 21% mean, 70% max, DEM drop of 6 m over 30 m
Noise from the road and rail
Low-lying end: about 9 m near the Brisbane River
sun_shade: Open; a large tree shades the park side to the west.
